finding.title: Replace hardcoded Color/Colors literals with theme tokens across tutoring screens
finding.why: ~33 sites across 6 screens (tutor_audit_log_screen.dart 11, accept_invite_screen.dart 8, decline_invite_screen.dart 6, invite_tutor_screen.dart 4, manage_tutors_screen.dart 2, manage_grants_screen.dart 2) use inline Color(0xFF...)/Colors.x.shadeN instead of AppColors/theme.colorScheme, despite AppColors already existing and being used one line away in decline_invite_screen.dart (AppColors.statusWarningSoft next to a raw Color(0xFFB07A00) for the same icon). This is exactly what the repo's own (currently non-enforcing) no_color_literal_outside_theme custom lint targets, and blocks a future dark-mode/theme change from reaching these surfaces consistently.
finding.recommendation: Add the missing semantic tokens to AppColors/AppTheme (status colors per TutorAuditAction, success/warning circles) and replace the literals; this is likely a repo-wide pattern worth fixing via the lint once custom_lint is unbroken, not just in tutoring.
acceptance_criteria: Once custom_lint is fixed, `dart run custom_lint` reports zero no_color_literal_outside_theme hits under lib/features/tutoring/.

finding.title: Guard int.parse(sel.profileId) in tutored_write_router.dart
finding.rule: EH-3/EH-4 (unhandled exception type breaks the class's stated contract)
finding.why: The class doc says 'CF failures... are re-thrown as TutorWriteException so callers can surface a clear snackbar,' but int.parse(sel.profileId) is called unguarded at 10 sites before any CF call happens. If profileId is ever non-numeric (malformed TutoredProfileSelection, future ID-scheme change), a raw uncaught FormatException propagates instead of the documented TutorWriteException — no AppLogger context, and callers that specifically catch TutorWriteException per this class's contract won't catch it. No test in s1_tutored_write_router_test.dart exercises a non-numeric profileId, so this is unconfirmed in practice.
finding.recommendation: Parse once via a small helper (e.g. `_profileIdOrThrow(sel)`) that logs via AppLogger and throws a typed TutorWriteException on failure, matching the class's documented error contract; call it once instead of int.parse at each of the 10 sites.
acceptance_criteria: A test that constructs a TutoredProfileSelection with a non-numeric profileId and calls any pushX method asserts a TutorWriteException (not FormatException) is thrown and logged.

finding.title: Add ref.mounted guards after awaits in manage_tutors_providers.dart's incomingTutorGrantsProvider
finding.why: incomingTutorGrantsProvider watches `authStateProvider.select((s) => s.currentUser?.firebaseUid)` and then awaits two network/DB calls before touching `ref.read` three more times (lines 118, 124, 131). If the watched uid changes mid-flight (e.g. the tutor signs out while this fetch is in progress — the exact account-switch race this file's own comments say it must defend against), Riverpod 3 tears down this build invocation and a subsequent `ref.read` throws UnmountedRefException instead of the intended AsyncError/graceful outcome. No `ref.mounted` check guards any of the three post-await reads.
finding.recommendation: Check `if (!ref.mounted) return const <TutorGrant>[];` (or equivalent) immediately after each await before touching ref again, mirroring the SM-4 pattern used elsewhere in Notifier methods.
acceptance_criteria: A test that invalidates authStateProvider's uid while incomingTutorGrantsProvider's future is pending does not throw UnmountedRefException.

finding.title: Reconcile tutoring test-file naming and duplication with AG-5 mirroring

evidence.quote: ws3_3a.._3h, s1_, s2_, s4_, r3_, t3_, f3_, ga5_, w3_41_, iter10_ prefixed files, no lib/ mirror

finding.why: Roughly 30 of the ~34 files directly under test/features/tutoring/ are named after a workstream/ticket id (ws3_3a...ws3_3h, s1_, s2_, s4_, r3_, t3_, f3_, ga5_, w3_41_, iter10_) rather than mirroring a lib/features/tutoring/** path, unlike test/features/tutoring/data/repositories/ and domain/use_cases/, which do mirror. This makes 'where is the test for file X' non-obvious (this audit had to grep several ways to find revoke/rescind/resign coverage) and has produced an actual duplicate: firestore_tutor_grant_repository_test.dart exists both flat (173 lines, largely tautological — see the TQ-8 finding) and at the correctly mirrored data/repositories/ path (1307 lines, the real suite), with no cross-reference between them.
finding.recommendation: Either formally document tutoring's workstream-based test naming as an accepted exception in coding-standards.md, or migrate the scenario tests under mirrored subpaths with the workstream id kept as a comment/tag; delete or merge the flat firestore_tutor_grant_repository_test.dart into its mirrored sibling.
acceptance_criteria: coding-standards.md states whether workstream-named acceptance-style tests are an accepted AG-5 exception (like story_acceptance/), or the tutoring test directory is reorganized to mirror lib/.

finding.title: Localize TutorPinValidationError.message instead of leaking raw English into tutor PIN screens

evidence.quote:
return const TutorPinValidationError(
        message: 'Tutor PIN must be exactly 4 numeric digits.',

finding.why: TutorPinValidationError carries a hand-written English message that both tutor_pin_setup_screen.dart and tutor_pin_entry_gate.dart assign straight into _errorMessage with no AppLocalizations resolution. The on-screen numpad only ever calls verifyTutorPin/setTutorPin with exactly 4 digits, so this specific branch is currently unreachable via the shipped UI — but it is a live landmine: any future caller (automation, a text-entry fallback, a reused validator) will render untranslated English to Hebrew users. This is the exact pattern already fixed for TutorGrantFailure elsewhere in the same feature, so the fix here is a straightforward extension of an established precedent.
finding.recommendation: Replace the message field with a stable code/enum and resolve it via AppLocalizations in both screens, mirroring the TutorGrantFailure fix.
acceptance_criteria: TutorPinValidationError carries a code, not a literal English string
tutor_pin_setup_screen.dart and tutor_pin_entry_gate.dart resolve the code via AppLocalizations with EN+HE parity
a widget test forces the validation-error branch (e.g. directly invoking the service with a malformed pin) and asserts the localized string renders
